title: 建築構造力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Structural Mechanics for Architecture II
keywords: Deflection curve 2.Buckling 3.Principle of virtual work 4.Slope-deflection method 5.Moment distribution method
educationalGoal: First, they must understand how to decide whether a structure is statically determinate or indeterminate. In addition, students learn to estimate structural deformation using the principle of virtual work and simple solutions for statically indeterminate structures. We give a lecture on the slope-deflection method and finding solutions using the linear moment distribution method of modeling statically indeterminate structures. Students will be able to solve for design stresses at the end of this class.
advice: 0. Solving static structures (full understanding) 1. Outline 2. Determination of statically determinate and statically indeterminate structures 3. Deformation of members 4. Principles of work 5. Solving statically indeterminate ramen using the stress method 6. Solving statically indeterminate trusses using the stress method 7. Buckling of compression members 8. Solving rectangular rigid frame using the slope-deflection method 9. Solving rectangular rigid frame using the fixed moment method
books: ステップアップ建築構造力学
requiredKnowledge: Students must have credit for Structural Mechanics for Architecture I.

activityGoals.body: Students can calculate structural deformation using the principle of virtual work.
Students can calculate statically indeterminate structures using the principle of virtual work.
Students can calculate of buckling loads.
Students can calculate stresses in rectangular frames using the slope-deflection method
Students can calculate stresses in rectangular frames using the fixed moment method.
